text:
[LGRA.5.8.5] **Only a `Json` slot chains.** Access that continues past a slot —
a bracket index or a further dotted segment — addresses a part of the slot's
value only where that slot is `Json`. Past a slot of any other builtin type the
compiler must refuse a bracket index, with `DS_VALIDATE_BAD_PATH`: the slot's
value has no parts to address. A dotted segment past such a slot is a member
read, which [LGRA.9.6.2] resolves and refuses. A schema-typed slot is
[LGRA.5.7a.3]'s case.

idris.name: Lgra_5_8_5__seg
idris.note: A segment of access that continues past a slot: a dotted member or a bracket index. The model reads one past a `Json` value alone (`lnul_8_4__path`); the compiler's refusal of a chain past any other slot is not modelled, and the fixture lowering admits no such chain.

idris.name: lnul_8_4__resolve
idris.note: What a segment addresses in the slot's value: a key the object's member, an index the array's element, segment by segment.
